lines.text: Grok in SpecWithCode: one task, planned, built and reviewed.
lines.spoken: Grok in Spec With Code: one task, planned, built, and reviewed.

lines.text: In your repo, run specweave init with the generic adapter. It adds AGENTS.md and seven SpecWeave skills. Then run grok --trust once, so Grok loads them.
lines.spoken: In your repo, run spec weave init, with the generic adapter. It adds agents dot M D, and seven spec weave skills. Then run grok dash dash trust once, so Grok loads them.

lines.text: Open SpecWithCode and set this Mac up as your main machine. Grok isn't in the first-run list, so continue past it.
lines.spoken: Open Spec With Code, and set this Mac up as your main machine. Grok isn't in the first-run list, so continue past it.

lines.text: Grok signs in with its own CLI. In Settings, Providers, SpecWithCode has already turned Grok on, because its CLI is signed in.
lines.spoken: Grok signs in with its own C L I. In Settings, Providers, Spec With Code has already turned Grok on, because its C L I is signed in.

lines.text: Add the repo: the plus next to Projects, Local folder, then its path. The project opens on its coordinator, and the model picker already shows Grok.
lines.spoken: Add the repo: the plus next to Projects, Local folder, then its path. The project opens on its coordinator, and the model picker already shows Grok.

lines.text: Set Full access for this demo, describe the change, and send it. The coordinator hands the work to a new thread.
lines.spoken: Set Full access for this demo, describe the change, and send it. The coordinator hands the work to a new thread.

lines.text: The thread plans increment 1: acceptance criteria and one task with its test. Then it changes the code and runs that test. A task is done only when its test passes.
lines.spoken: The thread plans increment one: acceptance criteria, and one task with its test. Then it changes the code, and runs that test. A task is done only when its test passes.

lines.text: Open the thread to review it: the summary, the verification and review reports, and every changed file in Open diff.
lines.spoken: Open the thread to review it: the summary, the verification and review reports, and every changed file in Open diff.

lines.text: Increment 1 is verified and closed. Next, run the same task with another agent.
lines.spoken: Increment one is verified and closed. Next, run the same task with another agent.
